criteria.reason: Fresh parse of the current ci.yml: the cache (step 4), download (5) and fonts (6) steps all carry continue-on-error=true, and Run Jest (7) has no if: condition, so a failed or timed-out install cannot skip it. Confirmed against ci.yml lines 78-100; actionlint exit=0 in it2-actionlint.txt.

Step bounds cache 1 min + download 3 min + fonts 2 min = 360 s; plus npm ci 3 s and Jest 87 s = 450 s, under the 600 s job limit (150 s headroom). Values match it2-parse.txt and ci.yml. (it2-parse.txt's trailing ARITH line still prints the older 390 s sum that omits the cache step; it2-arith.txt carries the corrected sum.)

The download step runs `timeout -k 5 80 npx playwright install chromium` (twice, then a warning) with no --with-deps; the parse prints 'steps before Run Jest with --with-deps: 0'. apt work is only in the separate step 6 (`playwright install-deps chromium`), bounded at 2 min and soft-failing.

All 96 suites ran and reported with Chromium unavailable (8 failed, 88 passed). The 5 non-browser failures are Chromium-independent: 4 fail identically with the browser present, custody.test.js is the known flake.

Literal count not observable here: 8 suites fail locally, 5 for local reasons regardless of Chromium (Node version vs mock-fs, sandboxed /tmp chmod, custody flake). The differential shows only the three browser suites (design-bundle, design-render, design-render-walk) depend on Chromium. A clean count needs the CI runner, which verification.md section 5 says cannot be reproduced here.

The browser-absent Jest run ends 'Tests: 33 failed' and JEST_EXIT=1; the fresh parse shows Run Jest carries no continue-on-error and the job has none either (ci.yml lines 35-41), so the job ends failed, not green.
Every failing test in the three browser suites reports 'Playwright's Chromium is not installed: run `npx playwright install chromium`' from design-render.js launch().
